external_entities.name: reader

external_entities.name: admin
external_entities.description: A person who maintains the database directly.
external_entities.source_excerpt: There is an admin who maintains the database directly
external_entities.notes: The admin connects from wherever they happen to be; there is no jump host.

external_entities.source_excerpt: Readers fetch those from the CDN over HTTP

processes.name: web server
processes.description: The server that receives public site requests, runs the CMS, and publishes assets to the CDN.
processes.source_excerpt: The web server runs the CMS and keeps pages, accounts and comments in a MySQL database

processes.name: CMS
processes.description: The content management system run by the web server.
processes.source_excerpt: The web server runs the CMS

data_stores.description: The database containing pages, accounts and comments.
data_stores.source_excerpt: keeps pages, accounts and comments in a MySQL database on the same hosted network

data_stores.name: CDN bucket

data_stores.source_excerpt: the web server pushes them up to the CDN's bucket

data_flows.name: access site
data_flows.description: A reader accesses the public site through the web server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: readers hit the web server over HTTPS

data_flows.name: fetch assets
data_flows.description: A reader fetches images, stylesheets and downloads from the CDN.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Readers fetch those from the CDN over HTTP

data_flows.name: keep content
data_flows.description: The web server keeps pages, accounts and comments in the MySQL database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: keeps pages, accounts and comments in a MySQL database

data_flows.name: publish assets
data_flows.description: The web server pushes newly published assets to the CDN bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When new assets are published the web server pushes them up to the CDN's bucket
data_flows.notes: The source does not state how this push is authenticated.

data_flows.name: maintain database
data_flows.description: The admin maintains the database directly through an unsecured MySQL connection.
data_flows.source_excerpt: There is an admin who maintains the database directly rather than through the CMS
data_flows.notes: The connection is straight to the box, has no TLS, and the admin connects from wherever they happen to be; there is no jump host.

trust_boundaries.name: hosted network
trust_boundaries.description: The hosted network containing the web server and MySQL database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The web server runs the CMS and keeps pages, accounts and comments in a MySQL database on the same hosted network.

assumptions.assumption: The web server is reachable from the internet because it serves the public site that readers access.
assumptions.basis: The source calls it the public site and says readers hit the web server.

assumptions.assumption: The MySQL database contains confidential data because it stores accounts and comments in addition to pages.
assumptions.basis: The database contents are stated as pages, accounts and comments; accounts and comments can contain information about people.

assumptions.assumption: The CDN bucket contains public data because its assets are fetched by readers from the CDN.
assumptions.basis: The source says readers fetch the images, stylesheets and downloads from the CDN.
